name: expand-product
job: Scale a validated product core with a measured ×N metric, core-path non-regression proof, and recorded new burden.

inScope: Framing the validated core and ×N target
Measuring the binding constraint and choosing one scale bet
Implementing on the correct layer with minimum observability
Verifying metric movement and core non-regression
outOfScope: Scaling a broken core or greenfield reinvention
Pure cosmetics and rewrites without scale slope
Hacks that cannot survive the target ×N

inputs: Validated core and ×N target (metric or surface count)
Cost, latency, compliance, and ownership constraints
outputs: Scale bet implemented and measured (or externally blocked with evidence)

tools: measurement for the scale metric or declared proxy
data: current metric baseline and core-path evidence
permissions: delivery access on the owning layer

failureSemantics: No scale claim without metric movement or a declared proxy plus core non-regression check; new operational burden is recorded; scope stays on the framed ×N.

outcome.observable: The ×N metric moved or is externally blocked with evidence, the core journey still holds, and the new maintain/finish burden is written down.
